select COUNT(*) as total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category='invoices' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as invoices, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category='receipts' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as receipts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category='notes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as notes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as cancelled from (select document_id as id,merchant_id,receipt_number as number,document_type,record_status,business,tin,created_at as issued_at,amount,document_source as source,sale_category,statutory_discount_amount,vat_relief_amount,discount_amount,manual_discount_amount,

                CASE WHEN document_type IN ('credit_memo','debit_memo','credit_note','debit_note') THEN 'notes' WHEN document_type IN ('payment_receipt','official_receipt') THEN 'receipts' ELSE 'invoices' END as category from (select `projection_id`, `id`, `document_id`, `transaction_id`, `merchant_id`, `receipt_id`, `original_invoice_id`, `document_source`, `document_family`, `category`, `status`, `sale_category`, `transaction_ref`, `receipt_number`, `business`, `tin`, `branch_code`, `rdo_code`, `document_type`, `record_status`, `transaction_status`, `payment_method`, `region`, `branch`, `channel`, `customer_name`, `customer_tin`, `tin_digits`, `seller_tin_key`, `seller_branch_key`, `document_number_key`, `seller_address`, `amount`, `statutory_discount_amount`, `vat_relief_amount`, `discount_amount`, `manual_discount_amount`, `vat_amount`, `vatable_sales`, `vat_exempt_sales`, `zero_rated_sales`, `sspt_sales`, `net_amount`, `payment_amount`, `payment_count`, `business_date`, `created_at`, `recorded_at`, `business_day`, `identity_key`, `tenant_identity_key`, `tenant_identity_count`, `tenant_identity_rank`, `rank_key`, `financial_valid`, `non_vat_centavos`, `verified_branch`, `projected_at`, identity_count,identity_rank from `ledger_documents` where `document_source` in (?, ?)) as `d`) as `ledger` limit 1
